camel_example: aliyun dataworks-public ListCatalogs --region cn-hangzhou --Order Asc --Comment this_is_a_comment --Types HIVE --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SortBy CreateTime --ParentMetaEntityId dlf --Name abc
description_en: Queries a list of catalogs in Data Map. Only catalogs of the Data Lake Formation (DLF) and StarRocks metadata crawler types are supported. For the DLF metadata crawler type, all supported data catalogs are returned. For the StarRocks metadata crawler type, data catalogs in a specific instance are returned
description_zh:
查询数据地图下的数据目录列表，当前支持dlf与starrocks类型。
dlf类型返回支持的所有数据目录列表，starrocks类型返回特定实例下的数据目录列表

name: ListCatalogs

parameters.help_en:
The parent entity ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2880092.html. Currently, only the DLF and StarRocks types are supported. For the DLF type, you can query all catalog lists. The format of `ParentMetaEntityId` is `DLF`. For the StarRocks type, you can query the catalogs of a specific instance. The format of `ParentMetaEntityId` `is StarRocks:(instance_id|encoded_jdbc_url)`.
`instance_id`: The instance ID. Required if the data source is registered in instance mode.
`encoded_jdbc_url`: The JDBC connection string encoded with URL encoding. Required if the data source is registered in connection-string mode
parameters.help_zh:
父层级实体ID，可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2880092.html。


当前支持dlf与starrocks类型。

对于dlf类型，支持查询所有目录列表，`ParentMetaEntityId`格式为 `dlf`

对于starrocks类型，支持查询特定实例下的数据目录列表，`ParentMetaEntityId`格式为 `starrocks:(instance_id|encoded_jdbc_url)`

其中  
`instance_id`: 实例ID，对应数据源以实例模式注册时需要提供  
`encoded_jdbc_url`: JDBC连接串的URLEncode编码,对应数据源以连接串方式注册时需要提供
